annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulations bind persons who operate remotely piloted aircraft, pilots, registered owners of remotely piloted aircraft, and RPAS operators (with the Minister also given duties).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system unless the registration number referred to in paragraph 900.16(3)(a) is clearly visible on the remotely piloted aircraft.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Regulations Amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations (RPAS – Beyond Visual Line-of-Sight and Other Operations)
